R1.description: A route naming an undeclared Codex model is accepted when codex debug models lists it, cached with a timestamp, and no lookup runs when all models are declared or added

R2.description: The pinned list is the floor: a failed lookup falls back to declared and added models, using a stale cache when present

R3.description: An unknown model is refused with exit 20 naming declared, discovered and added models and the harness.models setting

R4.description: The pages and the item record describe the lookup, cache, refusal and deferred follow-ups
